show_notes_text:
### Boomerang — Our Agency's Favourite Pitching and Email Tool

Boomerang for Gmail handles the follow-up problem that kills most outreach campaigns. Key features covered in the episode:

- **Boomerang reminders** — brings emails back to your inbox if no reply
- **Send Later** — schedule emails for optimal delivery times
- **Inbox Pause** — batch your email checking to stay focused
- **Respondable** — AI that predicts response likelihood before you send

**Get Boomerang:** https://www.boomeranggmail.com/referral_download.html?ref=5k36f
